Diana.combo: If Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark, approach while burrowed with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and leap out to knock her up. Follow with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered basic attacks, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. Against a fleeing Diana, hit her with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker's ranged attack, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Diana.phase: In the late game, enter with your team and knock up enemies instead of trying to reach the backline alone as Rek'Sai.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first against Diana's main damage. Also get movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Diana.escape: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, the opening comes when Diana E Lunar Rush is down. In particular, if she engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark, catch her with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup. If Diana W Pale Cascade is active, wait for its orbs and shield to disappear before going in.
Diana.fight: Start a fight after dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike or after Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark. Once Diana W Pale Cascade's orbs and shield disappear, knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and build Fury with empowered basic attacks. Finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and look for a flank angle so multiple allies aren't pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall. Engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush when Diana E Lunar Rush is down and your allies can follow.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge sideways instead of only backing away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush's cooldown may reset, so create distance. Don't engage right after Diana W Pale Cascade activates; wait for its orbs and shield to disappear.

Poppy.laning: When ganking, approach through open space without putting a wall or narrow passage behind you to avoid being stunned by Poppy E Heroic Charge. If Poppy’s thrown shield lands somewhere safe to step on, step on it first to prevent her shield. Before a fight, prepare an escape tunnel with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel within your allies’ vision.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choosing to stack health alone. You don’t need to prioritize magic resistance specifically to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Walk up while Burrowed, knock Poppy up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then immediately use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. When chasing a distant Poppy, damage her first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, but wait until Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge is an opportunity to close the gap. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Poppy is charging R Keeper's Verdict, first move out of its path before deciding whether to engage.
Poppy.fight: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in; walk up or wait for its duration to end. Once close, build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Poppy’s armor and magic resistance increase even when her health becomes low, so only fight to the end if your finishing damage is reliable.
Poppy.phase: During this phase, use the window while Poppy W Steadfast Presence and E Heroic Charge are down to get value from ganks and objectives. Rek'Sai’s damage falls off relatively in the late game, so engage with allies instead of chasing Poppy alone.
Poppy.teamfight: Engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush when Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, the enemy’s counter-engage crowd control has been used, and your allies can follow. After landing, use the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to knock up enemies and give your allies time to join. You can make use of Rek'Sai R Void Rush’s damage based on maximum health even while sticking to a durable opponent like Poppy.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush; wait for it to end or walk up. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it pushes you into a wall, so stay in open areas. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you with its first strike, leave the area before the second explosion. If Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close in, so dodge it by moving with jungle monsters between you. When Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is ready, don't group with allies or fight in narrow passages. Amumu W Despair deals continuous percent max-health damage at close range, so don't stay near him for long.
Amumu.escape: The opening comes right after Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy has been used. Amumu has no ability to create distance himself, so close in with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush and follow with a knockup. If Amumu still has crowd control available, make sure your allies are close enough to follow immediately before engaging.
Amumu.fight: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Amumu has no ability to create distance, so knock him up and follow with basic attacks and Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker. Instead of taking extended trades and repeatedly eating Amumu W Despair, build Fury, use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel while un-burrowed, and manage your distance.
Amumu.build: If being caught by Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is a problem, prioritize Tenacity or a way to remove crowd control. Then build magic resistance, and avoid stacking only health because of Amumu W Despair. Consider armor penetration as Amumu E Tantrum reduces physical damage.
Amumu.combo: Approach while Burrowed, knock Amumu up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered basic attacks. Build Fury to maximum with basic attacks and abilities, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel while Un-burrowed. To finish off a distant Amumu, hit him first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Amumu.laning: Set up tunnels that connect to lanes in advance to create gank opportunities before Amumu does.
Amumu.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online, so use tunnels to keep building an advantage through ganks and objectives. In the late game, Rek'Sai's damage becomes relatively lower, so engage with your team and knock enemies up instead of trying to finish them alone.
Amumu.teamfight: If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is still available, spread out from your allies and take fights in open terrain. Once it has been used and your allies can follow immediately, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. When health has been lost, briefly Burrow to heal, then fight again.

Elise.phase: If you avoid giving Elise early kills and stall the game, the matchup improves, and Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online. Rek'Sai's share of the damage falls off late, so start fights your allies can follow instead of trying to reach the enemy backline alone.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise's main ability damage. Also consider armor because she deals basic attack damage. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Elise.combo: When Elise E Cocoon is down, approach while Burrowed and knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered basic attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Elise used E Rappel, wait for her to land before starting this sequence.
Elise.escape: The opening for Rek'Sai comes right after Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are both down. If Elise has also just used Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush.
Elise.fight: Start a fight right after Elise E Cocoon and E Rappel are both down. If Elise has just used Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush. Once on her, build Fury with empowered basic attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
Elise.laning: Early on, establish plenty of vision so Elise can't get a kill with a gank, and don't push the lane recklessly when she is missing.
Elise.teamfight: When Elise E Cocoon has been used and your allies can follow immediately, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. After landing, knock the target up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to catch them with your allies. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then fight again.
Elise.watch: While Elise is airborne with Elise E Rappel, don't rush to use Rek'Sai R Void Rush; wait for her to land. If Elise transforms with Elise R Spider Form after health has dropped, she is looking for a finishing blow, so be ready to move.

Ivern.build: Tenacity is a priority because the path for Ivern’s allies to join after you’re rooted is dangerous. Magic resistance is effective against Ivern’s own Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern W Brushmaker, and Ivern E Triggerseed damage; armor won’t help.
Ivern.combo: Once Ivern Q Rootcaller has been used, approach with Burrowed Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel and knock the target up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow from beneath them. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered attacks, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. Against an Ivern escaping at range, hit him with Burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to mark him, then close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his only mobility ability, so right after he uses it is your window to engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Ivern E Triggerseed is on a target, go in after it bursts to avoid the slow.
Ivern.fight: Immediately after baiting out Ivern Q Rootcaller, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on a target, engage after the shield bursts, then once on them, use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to keep attacking and build Fury before finishing with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Ivern.laning: Use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to make Tunnels connecting to lanes and escape Tunnels in advance, expanding your gank routes. Don’t pass casually beside Ivern W Brushmaker brush that has just appeared.
Ivern.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in midgame as core items come online, so accelerate the game with ganks and objectives. Late game, start fights when your team can follow instead of diving deep to catch an enemy alone.
Ivern.teamfight: Watch out for Ivern Q Rootcaller and the knockup from Ivern R Daisy!, and engage from a distance your team can follow after the enemy’s counter-engage crowd control has been spent. Don’t engage immediately on an ally shielded by Ivern E Triggerseed; wait for the shield to burst, and pick off the ally Ivern is protecting instead of chasing Ivern deep. If you close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, knock them up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If health has been lost, Burrow briefly to heal.
Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, allies can dash in, so avoid the line by keeping minions or terrain in between before firing. If you move onto a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed right away, you’ll be slowed after the shield bursts, so wait for it to burst. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you, move to break up her consecutive attacks.

Brand.fight: The opening to close the gap comes right after Brand W Pillar of Flame has been used. If you aren't ablaze, Brand Q Sear won't stun you, so approach with Rek'Sai E Tunnel, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow, then stay on him and attack.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand's damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your max health, so consider movement speed to help you get out of Brand W Pillar of Flame's area instead of stacking only health.
Brand.combo: Approach with Rek'Sai W Burrow and knock Brand up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow beneath him. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and build Fury with empowered basic attacks, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at maximum Fury. Against a retreating Brand, damage him with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Brand.escape: If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear's projectile first, then close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Brand.laning: Don't stand next to minions Brand has set ablaze. Step to the side of the wave before going in. Rek'Sai builds Fury at camps and heals with Rek'Sai W Burrow while moving, and sets up tunnels to lanes in advance to find gank opportunities.
Brand.phase: In the late game, focus on starting fights when your allies can follow instead of chasing Brand deep on your own.
Brand.teamfight: Brand E Conflagration spreads around a burning target, and Brand R Pyroclasm bounces between enemies, so spread out from your allies before engaging. Once the stun threat has passed and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up after landing with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. If health has dropped, briefly heal with Rek'Sai W Burrow, then fight again.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you are hit by abilities in quick succession, then explodes, so dodging the first ability is important. If you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear's projectile to avoid being stunned. When Brand R Pyroclasm begins casting, spread out from your allies to reduce its bouncing damage.

Belveth.teamfight: When your allies can follow immediately and Bel'Veth W Above and Below has been used, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock her up after landing with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If an ally is killed and Void Coral drops, back off before Bel'Veth can pick it up. Delay teamfights while Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet's transformation is active.
Belveth.build: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If Bel'Veth's healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items to keep Grievous Wounds applied while Rek'Sai sticks to her with basic attacks.
Belveth.combo: Approach while Burrowed and, right after knocking her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered basic attacks. Once Fury is full, wait for Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom to end, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If she is far away, you can hit her first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed to mark her, then close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Belveth.escape: The opening comes right after Bel'Veth W Above and Below misses and Bel'Veth Q Void Surge becomes unavailable. Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back quickly, so close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then catch her with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then engage with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup before Bel'Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Follow with empowered basic attacks enhanced by Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel after Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends.
Belveth.laning: Set up tunnels that connect to lanes in advance with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to create more gank opportunities. Travel between camps while Burrowed and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai.
Belveth.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online, while Bel'Veth's stacks grow permanently and make her stronger over time. Build an advantage through early and mid-game ganks and objectives to accelerate the game, and start fights with your team in the late game.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks up and slows, and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge's cooldown, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so hold Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel's finishing damage and wait for it to end.

JarvanIV.laning: Build Fury at a camp, then travel in Burrow toward the next camp or lane to heal and set up a gank.
JarvanIV.combo: Then use empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, and finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
JarvanIV.phase: Both champions have significant influence in midgame, so Rek'Sai should build an advantage with ganks using Tunnels and objectives.
JarvanIV.teamfight: If health has been lost, Burrow briefly to heal, then fight again.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to prepare for Nidalee Q Javelin Toss / Takedown and W Bushwhack / Pounce damage. If Nidalee E Primal Surge's healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nidalee.fight: Avoid Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and W Bushwhack, and start the fight without a Hunt mark. Right after Nidalee W Pounce is down, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or R Void Rush. Once you're on her, keep up basic attacks with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at max Fury.
Nidalee.combo: Approach while burrowed and knock Nidalee up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow, then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and build Fury with basic attacks. Finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at maximum Fury. Against a Nidalee who has fled far away, hit her with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker to mark her, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock her up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after landing.
Nidalee.escape: The opportunity to engage with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or R Void Rush comes right after you bait out Nidalee W Pounce. Nidalee has no crowd control, so catch her with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow while Pounce is down.
Nidalee.laning: Check for Nidalee W Bushwhack in jungle entrances and river with a Control Ward or Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath's area attack as you move in. Travel between camps while burrowed with Rek'Sai W Burrow and heal, and pre-build Rek'Sai E Tunnel connections to lanes to set up ganks. In areas without vision, use burrowed detection to track Nidalee's movements.
Nidalee.phase: Mid game is Rek'Sai's peak once her core items are complete, so use tunnels for ganks and objectives to speed up the game. In the late game, take the role of engaging and knocking enemies up when your allies can follow instead of chasing Nidalee alone.
Nidalee.teamfight: Watch where Nidalee steps out to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and look for an engage angle. When your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. If health has dropped, burrow briefly with Rek'Sai W Burrow to heal, then fight again.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away it hits from, so be especially careful to dodge it when Nidalee is far away. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack in jungle entrances and river. If a spear or trap marks you as hunted, save Rek'Sai W Un-burrow for the moment Nidalee comes in with Nidalee W Pounce.

Skarner.build: If you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar first. Prioritize magic resistance, accounting for damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Magic resistance does not mitigate damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval or E Ixtal's Impact.
Skarner.fight: Right after baiting out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Once you're on him, keep up empowered basic attacks with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at max Fury. Don't let the trade drag on and allow repeated empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain and stuns on collision with a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. If caught by Skarner R Impale, you can't escape with a mobility spell, so keep your distance from Skarner, especially near the edges of objective pits. Also avoid trades where you stay close and keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval.
Skarner.phase: Build an early and mid-game lead through ganks and objectives to delay Skarner's tank item purchases. In the late game, start fights from a position where your team can follow instead of trying to kill the backline alone as Rek'Sai.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, approach while Burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. Immediately follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker to build Fury, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. If you're far away, damage him first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed to set up a leap with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Skarner.escape: Right after Skarner has fully spent E Ixtal's Impact is your window to go in with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel or R Void Rush. You can't escape Skarner R Impale with a mobility spell after it catches you, so manage your distance and choose your entry point before it hits you.
Skarner.laning: Around objectives, stay close to walls and pit edges so Skarner can't pull you with E Ixtal's Impact or R Impale.
Skarner.teamfight: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and your allies can follow, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. Don't jump in first if Skarner still has crowd control to retaliate with. You can also use the max-health damage from Rek'Sai R Void Rush when fighting a bulky opponent like Skarner.

Hecarim.phase: In the late game, take the role of starting fights when your team can follow, rather than trying to reach the backline alone as Rek'Sai.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first against Hecarim’s main sources of damage, Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge. If the healing from Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Rek'Sai can keep Grievous Wounds active during a fight by continuing to attack.
Hecarim.combo: Approach while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then emerge beneath Hecarim to knock him up. Immediately use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks to build Fury, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Hecarim runs far away, hit him with Burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to mark him, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge has been used, Hecarim can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so check whether both movement abilities have been used before engaging. In particular, before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is back up, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Hecarim.fight: Once on your target, use empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
Hecarim.laning: Move between camps while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t fear multiple people. When the enemy’s crowd control has been used and your team can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing.
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward your allies when he turns and starts running. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals from damage dealt to nearby enemies, so don’t fight him for long; move out of its area. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple people, so spread out from your allies.

Jax.phase: In the late game, start fights when your team can follow instead of trying to kill an opponent alone as Rek'Sai.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so first consider ways to reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t build only one type of resistance.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, approach while Burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and build Fury with empowered attacks, finishing with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at maximum Fury.
Jax.escape: Save Rek'Sai E Tunnel so you can move outside the stun radius when Jax E Counter Strike is active. When going back in, look for the window after Jax E Counter Strike ends and Jax Q Leap Strike has also been used.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike has finished. If he has just used Jax Q Leap Strike as well, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force your way into melee range.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group up; avoid the area stun. After the stun ends, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow and take him down with your team. When engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your team can follow immediately.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacks and the empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath. Its recast damage increases with each attack dodged, and it also stuns in an area, so move outside the stun radius and wait for Counter Strike to end.

MonkeyKing.phase: Even at this stage, long duels that let Wukong stack Wukong P Stone Skin favor Wukong, so keep fights short. In the late game, enter when your team can follow and knock up enemies instead of trying to kill the enemy backline alone as Rek'Sai.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Wukong Q Crushing Blow, Wukong W Warrior Trickster, and Wukong R Cyclone. However, Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor and Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, so don't rely on armor alone in a long fight. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
MonkeyKing.combo: After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used, approach while burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a Wukong who has fled far away, you can mark him with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window to engage opens before Wukong W Warrior Trickster comes back up. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Wukong R Cyclone has also just been fully spent, that's a chance to force a fight or an objective.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong P Stone Skin builds armor and healing with repeated hits, so trade short bursts of damage and disengage repeatedly. Check whether Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down; if Wukong E Nimbus Strike is also down, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Once close, build Fury with basic attacks and Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
MonkeyKing.laning: Set up tunnels connecting to lanes early and gank after checking Wukong's mobility. When the clone from Wukong W Warrior Trickster appears, don't use abilities on it; watch the real Wukong's direction of movement.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, spread out from your allies so you aren't knocked up together. When Wukong's crowd control has been used and your allies can follow immediately, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing. If Wukong is in Rek'Sai's range, you can also use Rek'Sai R Void Rush's damage based on his maximum health to catch him.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so dodge it from outside its range. The clone left behind by Wukong W Warrior Trickster doesn't move, so check which direction the real Wukong is heading before using an ability on that spot.

Viego.phase: At this stage, build an advantage through ganks and objectives, but don't give Viego a kill in small skirmishes you can't win. In the late game, rather than trying to reach the enemy backline alone, Rek'Sai should engage and knock enemies up when allies can follow.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and R Heartbreaker. If the healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Q Blade of the Ruined King is a problem in duels, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Viego.combo: Approach while Burrowed and knock Viego up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, then use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to max with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. If Viego escapes far away, you can hit him first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Viego.escape: The window to go in is when both Viego W Spectral Maw and R Heartbreaker are down. Then close the gap with the tunnel from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel or with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Viego is charging W Spectral Maw, dodge sideways or interrupt it with a knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow before fighting.
Viego.fight: When Viego W Spectral Maw is down, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow and follow with empowered attacks. If Viego R Heartbreaker is available, he can escape, so it's better to go in after that ability is down too. At max Fury, deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel.
Viego.laning: Clear jungle camps with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker, and Burrow between camps to convert Fury into healing. Dig tunnels toward lanes from early on to create gank routes. Don't push lanes toward visible Viego E Harrowed Path; avoid that route.
Viego.teamfight: Don't keep fighting near where an ally has fallen; knock Viego up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow to keep him away from the soul. If Viego possesses a soul, create distance and hold out until he returns to his original body, then counterattack. When entering with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's retaliatory crowd control has been used.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging. You can also interrupt the charge by jumping up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. If Viego E Harrowed Path is visible on terrain, watch for camouflage inside it and go around the route.

Briar.build: Build armor first against Briar's main damage from P Crimson Curse, Q Head Rush, and W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If her healing makes fights drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep Grievous Wounds applied with Rek'Sai's continuous basic attacks.
Briar.combo: Approach while Burrowed, knock Briar up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered basic attacks. Once Fury is full, finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If Briar is charging E Chilling Scream, save the knockup for that moment to interrupt both her healing and the wall stun.
Briar.escape: Don't engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down; check whether she can still use W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and R Certain Death. In particular, before Briar R Certain Death comes back up, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush while her mobility and crowd control are down.
Briar.fight: During Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, she attacks the nearest enemy, so take the front position to protect your backline. Interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream's charge with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then build Fury with empowered basic attacks and use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow to heal while the enemy's abilities are down.
Briar.laning: Briar has high kill participation early and tends to engage recklessly, so establish vision around lanes and create opportunities to counterattack. Don't linger in the middle of a lane where you have no vision. Use Rek'Sai's detection while Burrowed and tunnels you set up in advance to respond to Briar's movements. If you meet her in the jungle, you can lower her health and delay her next route even if you can't kill her.
Briar.phase: Briar has high kill participation early, so be wary of early engagements. In the late game, Rek'Sai's damage becomes relatively lower, so start fights your allies can follow instead of trying to kill her alone.
Briar.teamfight: Stand in the frontline along the charge path of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to protect your backline, and you can also intercept Briar R Certain Death's hemolith gemstone from the front. When Briar's counter-engage crowd control has been used and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. After landing, knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow to heal, then fight again.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor, so watch your spacing to avoid it. When Briar E Chilling Scream starts charging, don't stand with your back to a wall; interrupt the charge with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup. If hit by Briar R Certain Death's hemolith gemstone, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of fleeing alone.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko's main damage. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.combo: Approach while Burrowed, then knock Ekko up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered basic attacks. Finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Ekko gets far away, hit him with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Ekko.escape: Look for an opening when Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko W Parallel Convergence are down. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Don't rush in when only one of Ekko's mobility abilities is down, as he can escape with the other.
Ekko.fight: Ekko has no mobility immediately after using Ekko E Phase Dive to close in, so start the trade by knocking him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Build Fury with empowered basic attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don't chase deep just because health is low.
Ekko.laning: Clear jungle camps with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker's AoE empowered basic attacks, then Burrow while moving to the next camp and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. Early on, set up tunnels to lanes to create gank opportunities. If you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, approach from outside its area.
Ekko.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online, so turn opportunities when Ekko R Chronobreak is down into ganks and objectives. In the late game, take the role of engaging and knocking him up when your allies can follow instead of chasing Ekko to the end alone.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to close in, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and look for an opportunity to make him use Ekko R Chronobreak. Before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then fight again.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, get out of its area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and also dodge its return path. When you see Ekko's afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don't overextend to chase him even if health is low.

Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Evelynn Q Hate Spike, W Allure, and E Whiplash. However, Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so dodging before the mark matures comes first. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Evelynn.combo: Approach while Burrowed and, right after knocking Evelynn up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow, activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and follow with empowered basic attacks. Build Fury to maximum with basic attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite. Against an Evelynn who has fled far away, damage her with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock her up after landing with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow.
Evelynn.escape: When only Evelynn E Whiplash is down, don't rush in, as she can escape with R Last Caress. Before Evelynn R Last Caress comes back up, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or R Void Rush while her charm has also been used.
Evelynn.fight: While Evelynn W Allure's mark is maturing, don't fight her; back away. At maximum Fury, deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite.
Evelynn.laning: Place a regular ward near the jungle camp where Evelynn starts fights, and use a Control Ward to secure vision on gank routes. Rek'Sai travels between camps while Burrowed and heals with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then uses tunnels to create gank routes.
Evelynn.phase: Rek'Sai's damage becomes relatively low late, so take the role of engaging with your allies and knocking Evelynn up instead of chasing her alone.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets the backline, so move with your damage dealers in areas where your team has vision and save Rek'Sai W Un-burrow for her engage. When your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush on a target you've damaged, then knock them up after landing with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then fight again.
Evelynn.watch: When you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before you are charmed and alert your allies. When health is low, Evelynn R Last Caress deals much more damage, and she becomes untargetable as she casts it.

Fiddlesticks.build: If Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Fiddlesticks’ damage. If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap keep you locked down while you take prolonged ultimate damage, consider tenacity as well.
Fiddlesticks.combo: Approach while Burrowed, then immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker after knocking the target up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a distant Fiddlesticks, hit him with Burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to mark him, then close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing.
Fiddlesticks.escape: If Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap have been used, you can engage with less risk of being hit by crowd control. When closing in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, check the landing spot and your pre-made escape Tunnel.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt it with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow to reduce its healing and chance to recast. After knocking him up, use empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while unburrowed to build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If you can’t interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, don’t keep fighting inside its area.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Rek'Sai clears jungle camps with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, moves between camps while Burrowed, and heals with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. Maintain vision in the brush behind your lanes to prepare for Fiddlesticks’ ganks.
Fiddlesticks.phase: When Rek'Sai’s damage contribution falls off late, engage alongside your team and focus on knocking enemies up instead of chasing the backline alone.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the brush and approach routes near objectives, and spread out so you don’t all take Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm’s area damage. If you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling or Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, interrupt it with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow from within range. Engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush when your team can follow and Fiddlesticks’ crowd control has been used. If health has dropped, Burrow briefly to heal, then fight again.
Fiddlesticks.watch: When you see Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm channeling, interrupt it while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knockup. If you can’t interrupt it, leave its area. When Fiddlesticks hasn’t been seen for a while, don’t group up to enter brush without vision or narrow passages. Fiddlesticks P A Harmless Scarecrow may be present, so don’t even pass beside a stationary scarecrow until you’ve checked it.

Gragas.build: Gragas’ main damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. Gragas has high armor, which makes Rek'Sai’s physical damage less effective, so include penetration in your build. If his healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Gragas.combo: Once Gragas E Body Slam has been used, approach while Burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then immediately follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If Gragas gets away, hit him with Burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to mark him, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Gragas.escape: Engage immediately after Gragas E Body Slam has been used. If Gragas lands E Body Slam, its cooldown is greatly reduced and he can use it again, so only pursue deep when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.fight: The moment after you bait out Gragas E Body Slam is an opportunity to close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Once on him, use empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. Deal your big damage after Gragas W Drunken Rage’s damage reduction ends.
Gragas.laning: Pass through areas without vision while Burrowed to track Gragas’ movements.
Gragas.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in midgame as core items come online, so build your advantage through ganks using Tunnels and objectives. Gragas’ sustained damage falls off late, but Rek'Sai also has difficulty taking out the backline alone, so engage alongside your team and focus on knocking enemies up.
Gragas.teamfight: Be careful about fights in narrow passages and brush without vision so Gragas E Body Slam and Gragas R Explosive Cask don't scatter your team. When Gragas’ crowd control has been used and your team can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If health has dropped, Burrow briefly to heal, then fight again.
Gragas.watch: Gragas E Body Slam can knock you up and make it easy to get hit by Gragas Q Barrel Roll too, so immediately leave the barrel’s radius when you see it. When Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, his damage taken is reduced, so delay your big damage. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.

Graves.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. Graves’ primary damage is physical; only the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen isn’t blocked by armor.
Graves.combo: Approach while Burrowed, then immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker after knocking the target up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and follow with empowered attacks. Once Fury is full, finish with the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If Graves uses a mobility ability to get away, hit him with Burrowed Q to mark him, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up again with the reset W after landing.
Graves.escape: If only Graves E Quickdraw has been used, Graves can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so check which mobility abilities remain. In particular, before Graves R Collateral Damage is back up, leave the area of Graves W Smoke Screen, then close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Graves.fight: Fight back during the window when Graves fires two shots and reloads. Graves P New Destiny attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so keep an ally or minion between you and Graves in a skirmish, then close in after knocking him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
Graves.laning: Pressure the lane from early on to limit Graves’ chance to build stacks on Graves E Quickdraw. Rek'Sai should make a Tunnel connecting to the lane in advance, then move while Burrowed to create opportunities to heal and gank.
Graves.phase: Early on, Rek'Sai should gain an advantage through ganks and objectives to slow Graves’ growth. Rek'Sai is strong in midgame as core items come online, but Graves’ stacks build over time and Rek'Sai’s relative damage falls off. In the late game, engage with your team and knock enemies up instead of trying to kill them alone.
Graves.teamfight: When your team can follow immediately and the enemy’s counter-engage crowd control has been used, use Rek'Sai R Void Rush on a target you’ve already damaged, then knock them up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route, then close in again with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.

Karthus.build: All of Karthus’ damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor. Prioritize movement speed so you can dodge Karthus W Wall of Pain and get out of Karthus E Defile quickly.
Karthus.combo: Approach with Rek'Sai W Burrow, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow, and follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath. Build Fury with attacks and abilities, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite. If Karthus gets away, damage him first with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after landing.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no mobility or immobilizing ability, so if Karthus W Wall of Pain is placed, don’t pass through it; go around the outside to engage. Close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush, but don’t stay in Karthus E Defile for long.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so approach along a route that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain. After knocking him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow, keep attacking with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at maximum Fury. Even after killing him, don’t keep fighting near his corpse; move away immediately.
Karthus.laning: Use Rek'Sai E Tunnel to make an approach route connected to the lane in advance, and move between camps while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W to heal. Intervene in the lane early so Karthus can’t farm quickly without pressure.
Karthus.phase: Midgame is Rek'Sai’s strong point, so build your advantage with ganks using Tunnels and objectives. Late game, engage when your team can follow and focus on knocking Karthus up instead of chasing and trying to kill him alone.
Karthus.teamfight: Clear the frontline before Karthus enters Karthus E Defile’s area, and when engaging, make sure your team can follow immediately. If you go in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after landing. Karthus can still deal damage with Karthus P Death Defied after you kill him, so move away from his corpse and reposition.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so watch for its blast indicator and dodge; if possible, stand on top of an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain slows you and reduces your magic resistance when you pass through it, so path around the wall. After killing Karthus, move away from his corpse immediately to avoid the spells he continues casting through Karthus P Death Defied. Keep enough health after a fight to survive Karthus R Requiem.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn transforms into the Darkin and his healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kayn.combo: Approach while burrowed and follow the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow immediately with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker. Once basic attacks and abilities build Fury to maximum, deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a fleeing Kayn, damage him with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
Kayn.escape: Don't engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down; look for the window before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back up. After dodging the line from Kayn W Blade's Reach, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Kayn.fight: Pressure Kayn's jungle path and force objective fights before he transforms. When Kayn enters a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, interrupt him with the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Stay close, build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Kayn.laning: Early on, set up tunnels connecting to lanes with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to create gank angles. If you see the wall-edge warning that signals Kayn E Shadow Step, stop the fight and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.phase: Rek'Sai is strongest in mid game when her core items come online, so consolidate your advantage through ganks and objectives. In the late game, engage with your team to knock up enemies instead of chasing the enemy backline alone.
Kayn.watch: Kayn W Blade's Reach slows and knocks up, and being hit can lead into Kayn R Umbral Trespass, so dodge its line. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, while Kayn R Umbral Trespass heals Kayn, so be wary of extended duels.

Khazix.build: Build armor first to blunt Kha'Zix's main damage. If the healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Khazix.combo: Approach with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel while burrowed, then knock Kha'Zix up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with basic attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. Against a fleeing Kha'Zix, you can hit him with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Khazix.escape: The window for Rek'Sai to engage opens right after Kha'Zix E Leap is used. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, stay near your allies and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow when he reappears. Before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your allies can follow up at the landing spot.
Khazix.fight: As soon as Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Stay near allies to avoid being isolated, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then build Fury with empowered attacks and use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Khazix.laning: While clearing jungle camps, use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker's empowered AoE attacks, and travel between camps while burrowed to heal. Keep Kha'Zix from tracking your position when you're alone, and secure vision in river and the jungle entrance brush. Early on, create gank routes with tunnels and prioritize objectives.
Khazix.phase: Mid game is Rek'Sai's peak when her core items come online, but stop acting alone once Kha'Zix has two or more evolutions. In the late game, engage with your team to knock up enemies instead of trying to reach the enemy backline alone.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with your allies in a narrow area with vision to avoid the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush when Kha'Zix E Leap or the counter-engage crowd control is down and your allies can follow up. After landing, knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow; if your health drops, burrow briefly to heal, then fight again.
Khazix.watch: Stay near your allies, since Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals significantly more damage to isolated targets. Watch for Kha'Zix E Leap engaging and for Kha'Zix R Void Assault making him disappear and reappear. Control Ward cannot reveal Kha'Zix during Kha'Zix R Void Assault.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and E Mounting Dread. If healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and R Lamb's Respite makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Rek'Sai stays close and keeps attacking, so she can maintain Grievous Wounds during the fight.
Kindred.combo: Approach while burrowed and knock Kindred up from beneath her with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a retreating Kindred, hit her with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock her up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing.
Kindred.escape: Engage after Kindred has used both Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and W Wolf's Frenzy, especially before W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up. If Kindred E Mounting Dread is also down, that's a chance to close in while avoiding its slow and her repeated attacks. At that point, use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush to close the gap.
Kindred.fight: Don't engage just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; look for the window before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up.
Kindred.laning: If Kindred P Mark of the Kindred marks a jungle monster, take the camp first or secure vision nearby to delay her from claiming the mark. Pre-build tunnels connecting lanes and jungle with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, then look for ganks and pressure the enemy jungler's path from the early game. Travel between camps while burrowed to heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai.
Kindred.phase: Mid game is Rek'Sai's strong period, so consolidate your advantage with ganks and objectives while disrupting marks. Rek'Sai's relative damage falls off in the late game, so start fights where your allies can follow instead of chasing Kindred all the way alone.
Kindred.teamfight: When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, enter the zone so low-health allies can survive too. Before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used. After landing, knock Kindred up and hold her with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and if health has been lost, burrow briefly to heal before fighting again.
Kindred.watch: After Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied, continued attacks deal heavy damage based on your missing health, so back away or break vision when your health is low. Kindred can cast Kindred Q Dance of Arrows frequently inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't fight in the zone for long.

LeeSin.build: Build armor first against Lee Sin's main damage, the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. If Lee Sin sustains through a long fight with the omnivamp from Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, consider Grievous Wounds.
LeeSin.combo: Approach while burrowed and use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker immediately after knocking Lee Sin up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Follow with empowered attacks to build Fury as high as possible, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a Lee Sin who has fled far away, you can hit him with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
LeeSin.escape: The window to engage is after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses and before he can cast it again. If Lee Sin has just used Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will to engage, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush and focus your damage. If only one mobility spell is down, he can escape with another, so check which abilities he still has.
LeeSin.fight: If you meet Lee Sin in the early jungle, don't take the duel; retreat. After Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses, close in and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, build Fury with basic attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
LeeSin.laning: When ganking, use tunnels made with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to approach, then emerge beneath your opponent with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Travel between jungle camps while burrowed and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. Avoid direct early duels with Lee Sin while building a lead through ganks and objectives.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early jungle duels, so Rek'Sai should avoid direct fights. In the late game, engage with your team to knock up enemies instead of trying to reach the enemy backline alone.
LeeSin.teamfight: Spread out so you don't collide with allies kicked by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. When your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing. If health has dropped, burrow briefly to heal, then fight again.
LeeSin.watch: Spread out before team fights so Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage doesn't kick you into an ally.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia's main ability damage. Resistance can't reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, but Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If Lillia's healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Lillia.combo: Approach while burrowed and knock Lillia up from beneath her with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. Against a Lillia who has moved away, you can damage her with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Lillia.escape: The window to engage opens right after you bait out Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!. Also dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed to approach with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel while she has no movement speed stacks. Before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, first make sure you won't land alone.
Lillia.fight: Engage when Lillia has missed abilities and has no movement speed stacks. Right after Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is used, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Once close, build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
Lillia.laning: Clear camps with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, and travel between camps while burrowed to heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai. If you don't know Lillia's position, don't pass straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths. Pre-build tunnels connecting to lanes to create more gank opportunities.
Lillia.phase: Build a lead and speed up the game with early and mid-game ganks and objectives against Lillia too. In the late game, take the role of engaging and knocking enemies up when your allies can follow instead of chasing the enemy backline alone.
Lillia.teamfight: Save Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow's knock-up to catch Lillia when she comes in from the flank. Engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush when your allies can follow immediately and the enemy's counter-engage crowd control has been used. After landing, knock Lillia up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and attack together.
Lillia.watch: If hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed, you'll become a possible sleep target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when your health is high. If sleep has been applied, move to safety during the drowsy window while you can still move. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin its cast, move sideways to avoid the center.

MasterYi.build: Build health against the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, and consider ways to reduce his attack speed. If healing from Master Yi W Meditate becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
MasterYi.combo: Immediately after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow while burrowed. Follow by activating Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and building Fury with empowered attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If you need to start from far away, damage him first with burrowed Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is his mobility tool, so close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush right after he uses it. When entering with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, remember that it can only target someone you've recently damaged and you can't stop the leap, so check your landing spot first.
MasterYi.fight: Your chance to close in comes when Master Yi lands after being forced to use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike. Knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then build Fury with basic attacks and Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker; use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt it with the knock-up from the saved Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
MasterYi.laning: Master Yi is weak in the early jungle, so look for fights when you meet him and take early objectives to disrupt his scaling. Pre-build tunnels connecting to lanes to create more early gank opportunities.
MasterYi.phase: Master Yi is weak in the early jungle, so build a lead with Rek'Sai's ganks and objective control. Rek'Sai peaks in mid game when her core items come online, so keep that lead going. In the late game, Master Yi gets stronger and Rek'Sai's relative damage falls off, so start fights alongside your allies with Rek'Sai's knock-up instead of trying to kill him alone.
MasterYi.teamfight: Don't let Master Yi pick off an ally alone; group up and apply crowd control as he first engages. Knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends or when he activates Master Yi W Meditate. When engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, make sure your allies are close enough to follow immediately.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while casting Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow as soon as he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don't work, and attacks while Master Yi E Wuju Style is active deal some true damage, so avoid staying close and taking hits for long.

Nocturne.build: Build armor first against the main physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Q Duskbringer, and R Paranoia. If the healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Nocturne.combo: First strip Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed. Then knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, build Fury with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Un-burrowed and basic attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel at max Fury. If the Nocturne you damaged moves away, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up again with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow after landing.
Nocturne.escape: Once Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, you can stay close without worrying about its fear tether.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, first strip it with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. Follow with empowered attacks to build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel at max Fury to deal true damage. When the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror starts, create distance with a tunnel to avoid the fear.
Nocturne.laning: Set up tunnels toward lanes early to create gank routes, and maintain vision around the river and jungle entrances against Nocturne R Paranoia.
Nocturne.phase: Actively look for openings before Nocturne R Paranoia becomes available and while it is down, and widen your lead with ganks and objectives during the midgame as Rek'Sai's core items come online. In the late game, Rek'Sai's share of the damage falls, so start fights from a distance where your allies can follow instead of chasing the backline alone.
Nocturne.teamfight: When the screen goes dark from Nocturne R Paranoia, move toward your allies to avoid leaving anyone isolated as an engage target. Strip Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness and wait for Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror to be used; when your allies can follow, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. If health has dropped, briefly Burrow and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then fight again.
Nocturne.watch: If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, Nocturne can quickly approach along its remaining trail, so don't run in a straight line; turn toward your allies or a turret. Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror fears you if its tether remains, so keep Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel available to create distance as soon as it connects. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and doubles Nocturne's attack speed if it blocks one, so don't immediately use Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow to knock him up.

Nunu.build: If Nunu & Willump Q Consume’s healing keeps you from finishing them off, buy Executioner's Calling early between core items. Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage, and get tenacity as well if the snowball’s crowd control is a problem.
Nunu.combo: Approach while Burrowed, knock up Nunu & Willump with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If they run far away, hit them with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock them up again with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, which resets on landing.
Nunu.escape: Engage while Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush to get on them and fight.
Nunu.fight: Close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel while Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and E Snowball Barrage are down. Once you’re close, use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to keep attacking and build Fury, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury.
Nunu.laning: Another gank may come even after the first one, so Rek'Sai should use her detection while Burrowed to track movement and alert her allies. Prepare tunnels in advance with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to connect lanes and the jungle.
Nunu.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online, so build an advantage with ganks using tunnels and objective control. In the late game, instead of chasing the enemy back line alone, start fights with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and a knock-up when your allies can follow.
Nunu.teamfight: When you see Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero channeling, interrupt it with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knock-up. Engage when your allies can follow immediately and Nunu & Willump’s crowd control has been used. After closing in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, you can make use of its damage based on maximum health even while sticking to and fighting Nunu & Willump, who is very durable.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so when you see it, don’t just run backward; dodge by crossing toward the snowball. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to leave the area before the delayed root. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero applies an increasingly strong slow, so move out of its area unless you are in a position to interrupt it with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Consider tenacity as well if you keep dying while locked down by crowd control.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, approach while Burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker, then build Fury with empowered attacks and basic abilities before finishing with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Against a distant Rammus, hit him with Q while Burrowed, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock him up again with the reset W after landing.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, close the gap with a Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If you’ve already been taunted, time your actions so you can use a movement ability as soon as it ends.
Rammus.fight: Create distance while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, then focus your damage right after it ends. Build Fury with attacks and basic abilities, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel to get around Rammus’s high armor. When Rammus runs away, mark him with a ranged attack from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Rammus.laning: Prepare a Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnel to a lane early to create a gank route. On paths where you can see Rammus Q Powerball coming, keep minions between you and him to block his approach.
Rammus.phase: Rek'Sai is strongest in the mid game when core items come online, so build your lead with ganks using tunnels and objective control. Rek'Sai’s damage contribution falls off in the late game, so engage with your allies and handle the knock-ups instead of chasing the enemy back line alone.
Rammus.teamfight: When Rammus quickly rolls in with Q Powerball, retreat well outside the expected area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and don’t stay at its landing point. When counter-engage crowd control such as Rammus E Frenzying Taunt has been spent and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, stop basic attacks and target someone else or wait for its duration to end.
Rammus.watch: When Rammus starts rolling in with Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him, and move away from the expanded area of Rammus R Soaring Slam. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and abilities, so don’t stay within taunt range for long. While Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, even empowered attacks trigger reflected damage, so stop attacking.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. If the healing from Rengar W Battle Roar is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Rek'Sai stays close and keeps attacking, so you can maintain Grievous Wounds during the fight.
Rengar.combo: When Rengar W Battle Roar is down and he has no Ferocity for an empowered ability, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow while Burrowed. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and keep attacking to build Fury. At maximum Fury, finish with the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Rengar.escape: After avoiding Rengar E Bola Strike and letting it pass, you have an opportunity to engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, so if Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, stick to him with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow and continue the fight.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar has no Ferocity, and focus your damage after Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, then close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If Rengar’s empowered W is ready, don’t rush to use Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow’s knock-up.
Rengar.laning: When Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to gain vision of it. Early on, create a route to a lane with tunnels to increase your gank opportunities.
Rengar.phase: There isn’t enough information to determine who has the advantage against Rengar at each stage, so choose fights based on brush vision and whether Rengar has used Ferocity and his abilities. In the late game, instead of relying on Rek'Sai alone to deal damage, engage and knock up a target when your allies can follow.
Rengar.teamfight: Keep your formation so your back line doesn’t move ahead of your front line, and work together to counter-engage Rengar when he comes in with Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, knock him up and stick to him with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Before engaging with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, check that your allies can follow immediately, then knock him up again with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build Ferocity, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. At full Ferocity, Rengar E Bola Strike roots and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so check his resource bar and delay the fight. Be wary of Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt and don’t walk alone at low health.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage and can’t be blocked by magic resistance, while Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sejuani.combo: Approach while Burrowed, knock Sejuani up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks. At maximum Fury, deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. To finish from a distance, hit her first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock her up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after landing.
Sejuani.escape: The moment after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used is an opportunity to engage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If you’ve already been stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it ends to avoid the follow-up attacks. Dig an escape tunnel before the fight.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Sejuani’s Frost Armor is active, damage her first to remove the state that increases her defensive stats, then fight. Build Fury with attacks and basic abilities, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Sejuani.laning: Prepare a tunnel to a lane in advance to increase gank opportunities, and alert your allies when you detect Sejuani moving while Burrowed. Look for early jungle control and objectives before Sejuani becomes tanky.
Sejuani.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game, so use that advantage to accelerate the game. In the late game, Rek'Sai’s relative damage falls off and Sejuani becomes tanky with the time she gains, so start fights with allies instead of chasing the enemy back line alone.
Sejuani.teamfight: When Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or R Glacial Prison has been used and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. After landing, knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and make use of Rek'Sai R Void Rush’s damage based on maximum health even against a durable opponent like Sejuani. If health has decreased, Burrow briefly to recover, then fight again.
Sejuani.watch: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault dashes in and knocks you up, while Sejuani R Glacial Prison stuns for longer the farther it travels, so watch for its tell and dodge sideways. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath hits you with its first strike, move out of range before the second. Sejuani E Permafrost also gains stacks from basic attacks by her melee allies, so create distance when the stacks build up.

Shaco.build: Get a Control Ward and Oracle Lens early to deal with boxes. Against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, E Two-Shiv Poison, and R Hallucinate, build magic resistance first, and get some health as well.
Shaco.combo: After Shaco Q Deceive is used, approach while Burrowed and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. Immediately follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker to build Fury, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If Shaco gets away, you can hit him with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Shaco.escape: Shaco Q Deceive is his means of movement, so the moment he appears after using it is your window to engage. Check paths where Shaco W Jack In The Box may have been placed first, then close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush when you can avoid the fear.
