Shaco.fight: Immediately focus your damage with allies when Shaco reveals himself with Q Deceive. Close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then build Fury with attacks and Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker. At maximum Fury, use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco invades and ganks. After clearing a camp, Rek'Sai can move to the next one while Burrowed and recover health; dig tunnels to lanes in advance to create gank opportunities. If health has decreased, watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and avoid moving through parts of the jungle or brush without vision.
Shaco.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game, so build your lead with ganks using tunnels and objective control. In the late game, Shaco is weaker in isolated fights and Rek'Sai also has a harder time reaching the back line alone, so engage with your allies.
Shaco.teamfight: When Shaco enters a fight with Q Deceive, focus your damage on the real Shaco with your allies. Watch the health bar’s response so you don’t waste your damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone, and move away from the explosion and box when the clone dies. When the enemy’s counter-engage crowd control has been used and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock them up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow.
Shaco.watch: Be wary of the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box in brush without vision and around objectives; check with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens before entering. If Shaco appears with Q Deceive, keep your back to a wall or face your allies so he can’t get behind you. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone explodes and leaves a box when it dies, so move away immediately after killing the clone.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, E Molten Burst, and R Dragon's Descent. Get armor as well against her basic attack damage, and if the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Shyvana.combo: Approach while Burrowed, knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to maximum with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel. If she is far away, damage her first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker while Burrowed to mark her, then close in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Shyvana.escape: When Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down and her Fury bar is empty, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel or R Void Rush. Don’t use your knock-up while Shyvana is dashing in with R Dragon's Descent; catch her with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after she lands.
Shyvana.fight: Fight when Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty or Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down. Knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, then build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel at maximum Fury. If health has decreased, Burrow briefly to recover, then fight again.
Shyvana.laning: Pressure jungle camps and objectives early, before Shyvana builds stacks. Prepare a Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel tunnel to a lane in advance to increase gank opportunities. If Shyvana’s Fury bar is full, don’t start hitting an objective in front of her.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana while she has few stacks with Rek'Sai’s ganks and jungle invades. Rek'Sai peaks in the mid game as core items come online, so build an objective lead then. Shyvana’s permanent stacks build over time while Rek'Sai’s relative damage falls off, so accelerate the game.
Shyvana.teamfight: Engage when your allies can follow immediately, and deal with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s dash using Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after she lands. Keep your allies spaced apart so Shyvana’s area damage doesn’t hit several of you at once. After engaging, you can make use of Rek'Sai R Void Rush’s damage based on maximum health even while sticking to Shyvana.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful not to stay in a prolonged close-range fight after it hits you. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent can’t be stopped during its dash, so knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow after she lands. Her area damage is stronger in dragon form, so don’t group together with your allies.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and E Unraveled Earth. If you often get pushed by Taliyah W Seismic Shove across the rocky ground, get tenacity as well.
Taliyah.combo: Approach while Burrowed, avoiding the rocky ground, then knock her up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to build Fury with empowered attacks, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite. Against a Taliyah who runs far away, hit her first with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker to mark her, follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, then knock her up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow.
Taliyah.escape: The opportunity to engage is after Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down and before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back. Confirm that Taliyah W Seismic Shove has also been used, then close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush while going around any remaining rocky ground.
Taliyah.fight: Don’t engage along a path covered by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Go around the rocky ground to get close, then keep attacking with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to build Fury and use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at maximum Fury.
Taliyah.laning: Rek'Sai clears jungle camps with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and recovers health through Fury while moving between camps Burrowed. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, alert your allies since she may affect another lane, and create gank opportunities with tunnels dug in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Rek'Sai’s damage falls off relatively in the late game, so build an advantage with ganks and objectives in the early and mid game, then shift to starting fights alongside your allies in the late game.
Taliyah.teamfight: When Taliyah’s counter-engage crowd control has been used and your allies can follow, engage with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock up an enemy with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Don’t dash into an area covered by Taliyah E Unraveled Earth; if health has decreased, Burrow briefly to recover, then fight again.
Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while being cast, so don’t approach in a straight line; dodge sideways.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. However, armor can't mitigate the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and its Awakened effect has ended, approach while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W and knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. Immediately activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath and build Fury with empowered attacks, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite. Against a retreating Udyr, hit Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker to mark him, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after landing.
Udyr.escape: Right after you make Udyr use E Blazing Stampede is your window to close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you once, you can retaliate while he can't stun the same target again. During the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects don't work, so hold Rek'Sai W Un-burrow and knock him up after the effect ends.
Udyr.fight: When Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, pressure him with consecutive attacks using Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath. Build Fury with attacks and abilities, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite to deal true damage. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has stunned you once, retaliate or disengage while he can't immediately stun the same target again.
Udyr.laning: Since you're playing Rek'Sai in the jungle against Udyr, track his path with vision on key routes and jungle entrances. Let your allies know his path so they don't push up in lane while he's missing. Move between camps while Burrowed with Rek'Sai W and convert Fury into healing, and set up Rek'Sai E Tunnel toward lanes in advance to create gank angles.
Udyr.phase: Use tunnels to gank and secure objectives during this period to build a lead and speed up the game. In the late game, Rek'Sai's damage becomes relatively low, so start fights with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and Rek'Sai W Un-burrow when your allies can follow.
Udyr.teamfight: Don't insist on attacking only Udyr when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield; take out weaker enemies behind him first to create a numbers advantage. If your allies can follow immediately and Udyr E Blazing Stampede's stun is down, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock up the target with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow. If health has decreased, briefly Burrow with Rek'Sai W to heal, then fight again.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns, so watch for the stun right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and R Wingborne Storm deal max-health damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm also slows. During the Awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects don't work, so use Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after the Awakened effect ends.

Vi.build: Buy armor items first. Vi W Denting Blows reduces armor and deals damage based on max health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase health. Attack-speed reduction also helps limit Vi's consecutive attacks.
Vi.combo: When Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, approach while Burrowed and knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow. Immediately use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker and build Fury with empowered attacks, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel at max Fury. Against a distant Vi, hit her with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed to follow up with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Vi.escape: Right after Vi uses her mobility tool, Q Vault Breaker, is your window to go in with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. If she has also used R Cease and Desist, counterattack with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow after she lands and finishes the knock-up. If you need an escape route, dig a tunnel before the fight.
Vi.fight: Immediately after dodging or making Vi use Q Vault Breaker, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, trade after it is stripped, and keep the fight short before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up.
Vi.laning: Early on, set up tunnels toward lanes and tunnels to escape after a fight, securing gank and retreat routes. Detect Vi's movements while Burrowed and alert your allies.
Vi.phase: In the early and midgame, use the window when Vi Q Vault Breaker is down to get ahead through ganks and objectives. In the late game, instead of chasing the backline alone, enter when your allies can follow and knock enemies up.
Vi.teamfight: When Vi R Cease and Desist is available, move with your allied backline carries so they don't go alone out of vision. Once Vi's retaliatory crowd control has been used and your allies can follow, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow after landing. If health has decreased, briefly Burrow and heal with Rek'Sai P Fury of the Xer'Sai, then fight again.
Vi.watch: When Vi charges Q Vault Breaker, back away or move sideways to dodge it. Vi W Denting Blows reduces the target's armor and increases Vi's attack speed as she keeps hitting the same target, so don't fight her for long. While Vi is charging toward you with R Cease and Desist, don't try to knock her up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow; use it after she lands and finishes the knock-up.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Q Jaws of the Beast, and R Infinite Duress. Also get armor against his basic attack damage. If his healing makes it hard to finish him, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and keep applying Grievous Wounds with basic attacks.
Warwick.combo: After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl is down, knock him up with Rek'Sai W Un-burrow and activate Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to follow with empowered attacks. Build Fury to max with attacks and abilities, then finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite. If Warwick gets away, damage him with Rek'Sai Q Prey Seeker to set up a chase with Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Warwick.escape: Don't go in just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down; look for a window when he also can't use R Infinite Duress. Once the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has also been used, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush.
Warwick.fight: Don't use burst while Warwick E Primal Howl is active; go back in after the fear. Use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath to follow with empowered attacks and build Fury, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite at max Fury. Warwick can heal even when his health is low, so don't dive based only on his health.
Warwick.laning: Early on, exploit Warwick's slow jungle clear by invading with lane priority. Set up both entry and escape routes between lanes and the jungle in advance with Rek'Sai E Tunnel and use them for ganks. If health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt may lead to a chase, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: Rek'Sai peaks in the midgame as her core items come online, so build a lead through ganks and objectives by then. In the late game, Rek'Sai's relative damage falls, so start fights with your allies instead of trying to reach the enemy backline alone.
Warwick.teamfight: Warwick R Infinite Duress can reach from far away when he has high movement speed, so watch bushes where you have no vision and the far side of pits during objective standoffs. Once the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl is used and your allies can follow, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Un-burrow after landing. If Warwick suppresses an ally with R Infinite Duress before Rek'Sai uses R, focus on saving the bound ally.
Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and then fears you, so back off and re-engage after the fear. Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses you on hit, and the higher his movement speed, the farther away he can hit from. When health falls below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position and increases his movement and attack speed.

XinZhao.build: Xin Zhao's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Xin Zhao P Determination is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
XinZhao.combo: Approach while Burrowed and, right after knocking Xin Zhao up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, use Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker and follow with empowered attacks. At max Fury, finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. Against a distant Xin Zhao, damage him first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed, then follow with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow after landing.
XinZhao.escape: Right after Xin Zhao uses E Audacious Charge is your window to go in with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel or Rek'Sai R Void Rush. If the third attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike is still coming, first get out of range to avoid the knock-up. Re-engage and counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving sideways, and close the gap right after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Once close, build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker, then use Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. You can also counterattack after Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's immunity ends.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, dig tunnels toward lanes and detect Xin Zhao's movements to alert your allies. When chasing Xin Zhao, drive him into an area where there are no targets behind him for Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge to use.
XinZhao.phase: In the late game, Rek'Sai's relative damage falls, so enter with your allies instead of chasing enemies behind Xin Zhao alone. Use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as a counterattack window in late-game fights.
XinZhao.teamfight: Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard's knockback can split your allies' formation, so don't stand too close together. Once Xin Zhao's retaliatory crowd control is used and your allies can follow, enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock enemies up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow after landing. If health has been lost, briefly Burrow and heal, then fight again.
XinZhao.watch: The third basic attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike knocks you up, so if you've been hit twice, get out of range with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. Move sideways to dodge the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don't try to deal damage from outside spear range.

Zac.build: If the healing from Zac P Cell Division is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, W Unstable Matter, and E Elastic Slingshot.
Zac.combo: Approach while Burrowed and knock Zac up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, then build Fury with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker. At max Fury, finish with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. Against a distant Zac, damage him first with Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker while Burrowed to mark him, then leap with Rek'Sai R Void Rush and knock him up with the reset Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow.
Zac.escape: The window to go in is right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down. If Zac is charging, interrupt him first with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, then fight. Before going in with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, check the landing spot and the escape tunnel you dug in advance.
Zac.fight: Right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot is down, close the gap with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel. Once close, follow with empowered attacks from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker to build Fury, then deal true damage with Rek'Sai E Furious Bite/Tunnel at max Fury. Walk over the body chunks Zac drops to prevent him from healing.
Zac.laning: Set up tunnels toward lanes and tunnels to escape after a fight from early on, and detect Zac's movements while Burrowed to alert your allies.
Zac.phase: Get ahead in the early and midgame through ganks and objectives, but check before the fight whether Zac P Cell Division's revival is available. In the late game, take the role of entering and knocking enemies up when your allies can follow instead of going deep alone.
Zac.teamfight: Interrupt or absorb Zac E Elastic Slingshot's engage with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow, then enter with Rek'Sai R Void Rush from a distance where your allies can follow. When fighting close to Zac, step on his body chunks to prevent healing, and use the area damage from Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath/Prey Seeker on chunks created by Zac P Cell Division. If health has been lost, briefly Burrow and heal, then fight again.
Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot charges and then dashes to knock you up, so if you see him charging behind a wall, jump up with Rek'Sai W Burrow/Un-burrow to interrupt him. If you stay close after being hit by the slow and knock-up from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, you're likely to also take max-health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, so create distance after absorbing his engage.
